Commissioned by the human 2026-08-05/06 from the lane-quality assessment. The hole: nothing mechanical stops a vacuous green test. The defences today are red-first discipline (briefing prose, unenforced for a foreign session), the non-vacuity-by-mutation habit visible in many closes (habit, not gate), the probe vacuity rule (#116, probes only), and mutmut — scoped to two modules and per #172's close currently not running against our pytest config at all.

Scope: (1) fix or replace mutmut so mutation testing runs under the current pytest/xdist config — evaluate alternatives honestly (cosmic-ray, a bespoke mutator per ADR-0049's spend-tokens-once principle) and pick on evidence; (2) widen the mutation scope beyond snapshot/planner to a practical tier — at minimum, every new test module a landing adds gets a mutation smoke (kill rate over a bounded mutant sample) as part of the gate, so a vacuous suite reds mechanically; (3) bind it into just fast or a named recipe with a cost budget stated (the tier's wall time matters — #197's parallelism is the precedent); (4) the check must apply lane-blind: a z.ai or Codex landing meets exactly the same red. Acceptance: a deliberately vacuous test module (assert-true shaped) is demonstrated red by the gate; the current tree passes; wall-time cost quoted.
